raw.query: SELECT v1.run_id AS react_run, v2.run_id AS static_run, ver_react.provisioned_ws AS react_ws, ver_static.provisioned_ws AS static_ws, ver_react.provisioned_ws / ver_static.provisioned_ws AS cost_ratio, ver_react.enc_p99 AS react_p99 FROM v_dim v1 JOIN v_dim v2 ON v2.run_id = 'a13:ft_static_C8' AND v2.is_current = true JOIN verification ver_react ON ver_react.resolved_run_id = v1.run_id JOIN verification ver_static ON ver_static.resolved_run_id = v2.run_id WHERE v1.run_id = 'a13:ft_reactive_L30' AND v1.is_current = true;
raw.evidence: Run a13:ft_reactive_L30 has encoder p99 of 588.4 ms and achieves a cost ratio of 0.6868x relative to the deployable C=8 static baseline (3323189.5 / 4838397.6 worker seconds).
raw.fix: No fix needed; the claimed values are accurate rounds of the database measurements.
